THE ONE headings-only end-of-line metadata emitter ([ap:UH0UOU]): every covered surface's heading suffix comes from HERE and nowhere else. One vocabulary with dock.peek: when the policy carries the render's source_metrics index, the suffix is exactly format_dock_peek_metrics over the same build_dock_peek_index engine (counts/bytes cover the FULL pinned-cache subtree -- completed and suppressed descendants included, never the filtered render forest). THE EXEMPTION: a managed source line (managed_metadata. is_managed_source_line -- a Cartographer/beacon source-map marker in the note's FIRST line) is source code and carries NONE of it, not even the legacy child count; an unmanaged parent of a managed subtree still shows its metrics (they legitimately include the managed descendants). No index in hand (an ad-hoc render with no cache operand) keeps the prior child-count-only suffix byte-for-byte; a uuid missing from a present index renders explicit '?' fields, never a silent zero. Pure; no I/O.
